feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 28 May 2026 4:49am
items.description:
##Today##

Any showers at first will soon clear leaving the rest of the day dry. Some sunny spells at first but turning cloudier at times with a risk of mist or fog patches developing from the south this afternoon and evening. Dry overnight as any mist clears.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 20°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-4 at first


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

E or SE 15-20, occasionally 25 at first this morning, decreasing 10-15 this afternoon, veering S or SW 20-25 late afternoon or early evening. Decreasing 15-20 tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor in mist and very poor in any fog patches. Hill fog developing.


##Comments##

Strong winds in places at first.


##Tomorrow##

Dry with sunny/ clear intervals.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15-20 decreasing 10-15 during the afternoon, then backing S or SW later.


##Visibility##

Good. Patchy hill fog at first and later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Saturday, 30 May 2026##

Dry with sunny intervals, but soon turning cloudier with outbreaks of rain arriving around early afternoon, these clearing late in day/ overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 10-15, increasing 15-20, then 20-25 for a time in the evening for a time, veering W or SW 15-20 later.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in rain. Hill fog developing.


##Comments##

The beginning of a more unsettled spell.


##Sunday, 31 May 2026##

Sunny intervals and isolated showers. Rain arriving towards end of night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-5


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 15-20, backing 10-15 later, decreasing 5-10 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain late. Hill fog late.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Monday, 1 June 2026##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain through much of the day.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

6-12


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S 10-15, veering SW 15-20.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.
